integrity: Exact integer computation and finite-field evaluations are reproducible supporting checks; they do not replace the geometric infinite-prime proof. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies algebraically closed prime characteristics at least 13 only, and relies on the known complex Wronskian factorization and classical invariant quotient. The integral scalar and modular orbit collision proof are given. The accessible 2019 article was limited to abstract; priority and independent mathematical validation remain open.
title: Three exceptional characteristics for the third-canonical Weierstrass divisor of the Klein quartic
